node.label: Eosinophilic infiltration of the esophagus
node.definition: Infiltration of numerous eosinophils (usually greater than 15 per high power field) into the squamous epithelium of the esophagus, and layering of eosinophils on the surface layer of the esophagus.

diseases.label: neurodevelopmental disorder with coarse facies and mild distal skeletal abnormalities

evidence.snippet: Stolerman neurodevelopmental syndrome: Eosinophilic infiltration of the esophagus (frequency 1/1) [PCS]
